author: larsen66
description: A standalone React marketing homepage adapted from the MIT-licensed Payload website. Dark architectural grid, layered product screenshots, animated glass background, responsive navigation, feature tabs, carousel and accordion. Local assets and OFL fonts; no CMS or account setup required. Includes source and attribution.
